verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Grafana can query/visualize data from many sources (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, CloudWatch, etc.) and community confirms broad data source integrations for hosts, cloud, and metrics/logs/traces, but the evidence pack lacks explicit mention of vendor-maintained agents like Grafana Alloy, Kubernetes-specific integrations/operators, or a curated catalog of cloud-service integrations. missing for 10: dedicated docs on Grafana Alloy/agent instrumentation, Kubernetes monitoring integration specifics, cloud-provider integration catalog, and independent hands-on validation of agent-based instrumentation across hosts/containers/K8s/cloud.
